about_the_game:
Sime Is Back 18+ takes the beloved retro-inspired platformer into full chaos!

Explore a sprawling underground temple and travel to a different worlds, collect shiny diamonds and keys, and unlock new levels in a mysterious world hub packed with that nostalgic charm you’ve come to love. It’s everything you’d expect from a fun, lighthearted 3D platformer…

Until it isn’t.

What awaits behind the final doors is nothing you could have anticipated. The game takes a sharp, unexpected turn.

🕹️ Classic 3D Platforming… at First – Run, jump, and collect in a nostalgic adventure.

🧩 Solve Creative, Action-Based Puzzles - Defeat enemies and progress through the game!

🔑 A World Hub – Unlock new areas and uncover the mysteries of the underground temple.

💎 Collect Diamonds - Progress and unlock bonuses throughout the game!

👀 A Completely Normal Ending… – Nothing weird happens.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains violence and blood in its final sequences. While most of the game plays like a traditional lighthearted 3D platformer, the ending features a sudden shift in tone and a depiction of a character using a firearm in a violent manner.

There are no depictions of sexual content, drug use, or self-harm, but the unexpected nature of the ending may be unsettling to some players.
